dos.text: Treat this as a dismissible chip-style UI, not a reusable Acorn primitive, the one real analog in mozilla-central (ai-website-chip) is purpose-built for a single feature, not a generic component to extend.

donts.text: Don't go looking for a generic chip class or shared styles to reuse, no such component exists yet, a new one needs its own real implementation rather than assuming one is hiding somewhere.
